body: Author self-review before reviewer verdict: the candidate encoder emits exactly the four authorized root fields, but decode currently ignores unknown extra root keys. An input with an added canonicalText or arbitrary field can therefore decode and re-encode without that field. I have asked both reviewers whether the chief contract phrase "StoryId, canonical source checksum, units; no source text" and canonical-wire discipline requires exact root-key rejection, or whether only encoder output plus unit order is intended to be canonical. I will accept HOLD and issue an immutable successor with a discriminating court if they judge this a contract miss; I will not amend the frozen commit.
